messages:
Rina: quick thread: noticed several places using different labels for the same in-console help surface: top-nav tooltip says 'Help', docs panel header says 'Reference', and some tooltips say 'Docs'. This is causing confusion in the beta survey. can we converge?

Marco: +1. my vote is for 'Docs' — short and matches the canonical docs.site. we'll need to sweep console strings and update nav tooltips, panel titles, and button aria-labels.

Tess: accessibility/regression note: when the panel opens via keyboard the focus currently lands on the panel container which is not announced by SR. we should focus the heading and add aria-labelledby. also add an aria-live="polite" region for deep-link arrivals (announce 'Showing section: X').

Eli: implementation plan: intercept internal doc anchors and call history.pushState({openDocs:section}) to mount the panel client-side rather than full navigation. save `prevActive = document.activeElement` on open and `prevActive?.focus()` on close. also ensure external anchors keep target=_blank but include aria-label 'opens in a new tab'.

AxeBot: automated scan: external links missing accessible name, role=dialog missing aria-labelledby, and contrast issue on small callout badge (3.3:1) on dark theme. recommend updating badge token to meet 4.5:1 and add aria attributes.

Rina: for copy: propose we replace 'Reference' and 'Help' with 'Docs' everywhere. short sidecar intro: 'Docs: quick reference and runnable examples for Console features.' will update docs.site if we go forward.

Marco: micro-UX: when an external doc link opens a new tab, show a small non-blocking toast 'Opening Docs in a new tab' with an action 'Return to Console' that focuses the console window. helpful for users who lose context.

Tess: QA checklist: keyboard open/close focus restoration, screen reader announces highlighted section on deep-link, aria-labels for external links, contrast token change validation, and e2e test for pushState behavior.

Eli: branch `feature/consistency/docs-labels-1823` created. will include string changes, focus-handling, aria fixes, and badge token update + tests. deploying to staging after CI.

Rina: thanks. once staging is up please drop link + a 5s screencap showing keyboard open -> esc -> focus restore. tagging @design for visual verification and @eng-oncall for deploy window. :pray:
